_comment: QUARTZ, and material_economy named this source years before the dimension existed:
'Quartz | Circuit oscillators (real!), old clocks, countertops'. A quartz crystal really is
what keeps a circuit board's clock, so recovering it from fused boards is the literal truth
rather than a convenient fiction - which is the standard the whole material matrix is held to.
Separating rather than pulverizing because a board is a mixture and this divides it. The
byproduct is circuit powder, which is stage one of the EXISTING gold chain (#120) - so the
depths make gold faster without a second route to it.
Ratio and cost are first-pass; #36 owns the numbers.
